an8.54:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Koḷiyesu viharati Kakkarapattaṃ nāma Koḷiyānaṃ nigamo.
an8.54:1.2: Atha kho Dīghajānu Koḷiyaputto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Dīghajānu Koḷiyaputto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.54:1.3: ‘mayaṃ bhante gihī kāmabhogī puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasāma kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhoma mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārayāma jātarūparajataṃ sādiyāma,
an8.54:1.4: tesaṃ no bhante Bhagavā amhākaṃ tathā dhammaṃ desetu, ye amhākaṃ assa dhammā diṭṭhadhammahitāya diṭṭhadhammasukhāya samparāyahitāya samparāyasukhāyā' ti. 2.
an8.54:2.1: Cattāro 'me Byagghapajja dhammā kulaputtassa diṭṭhadhammahitāya saṃvattanti diṭṭhadhammasukhāya.
an8.54:2.5: Idha Byagghapajja kulaputto yena kammaṭṭhānena jīvikaṃ kappeti
an8.54:2.6: yadi kasiyā yadi vaṇijjāya yadi gorakkhena yadi issatthena yadi rājaporisena yadi sippaññatarena,
an8.54:2.7: tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatrupāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.
an8.54:3.2: Idha Byagghapajja kulaputtassa bhogā honti uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sedāvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā,
an8.54:3.4: ‘kinti me ime bhoge neva rājāno hareyyuṃ, na corā hareyyuṃ, na aggi ḍaheyya, na udakaṃ vaheyya, na appiyā dāyādā hareyyun' ti?
an8.54:4.2: Idha Byagghapajja kulaputto yasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā paṭivasati, tattha ye te honti gahapati vā gahapatiputtā vā daharā vā vuddhasīlino vuddhā vā vuddhasīlino saddhāsampannā sīlasampannā cāgasampannā paññāsampannā, tehi saddhiṃ santiṭṭhati sallapati sākacchaṃ samāpajjati; yathārūpānaṃ saddhāsampannānaṃ saddhāsampadaṃ anusikkhati, yathārūpānaṃ sīlasampannānaṃ sīlasampadaṃ anusikkhati, yathārūpānaṃ cāgasampannānaṃ cāgasampadaṃ anusikkhati, yathārūpānaṃ paññāsampannānaṃ paññāsampadaṃ anusikkhati.
an8.54:5.2: Idha Byagghapajja kulaputto āyañ ca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayañ ca bhogānaṃ viditvā samaṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti na accogāḷhaṃ na atihīnaṃ ‘evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya thassatī' ti.
an8.54:5.3: Seyyathā pi Byagghapajja tulādhāro vā tulādhārantevāsī vā tulaṃ paggahetvā jānāti ‘ettakena vā onataṃ ettakena vā unnatan' ti, evam
an8.54:5.4: eva kho Byagghapajja kulaputto āyañ ca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayañ ca bhogānaṃ viditvā samaṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti na accogāḷhaṃ na atihīnaṃ ‘evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī' ti.
an8.54:5.5: Sacāyaṃ Byagghapajja kulaputto appāyo samāno uḷāraṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti, tassa bhavanti vattāro ‘udumbarakhādikaṃ 'vāyaṃ kulaputto bhoge khādatī' ti.
an8.54:5.6: Sace panāyaṃ Byagghapajja kulaputto mahāyo samāno kasiraṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti, tassa bhavanti vattāro ‘ajaddhumārikaṃ 'vāyaṃ kulaputto marissatī' ti.
an8.54:5.7: Yato ca khvāyaṃ Byagghapajja kulaputto āyañ ca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayañ ca bhogānaṃ viditvā samaṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti na accogāḷhaṃ na atihīnaṃ ‘evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī' ti.
an8.54:6.1: Evaṃ samuppannānaṃ Byagghapajja bhogānaṃ cattāri apāyamukhāni honti:
an8.54:6.2: itthidhutto hoti, surādhutto, akkhadhutto, pāpamitto pāpasahāyo pāpasampavaṅko.
an8.54:6.3: Seyyathā pi Byagghapajja mahato taḷākassa cattāri c' eva āyamukhāni cattāri ca apāyamukhāni,
an8.54:6.4: tassa puriso yāni c' eva āyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya, yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni vivareyya,
an8.54:6.5: devo ca na sammā dhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya;
an8.54:6.6: evaṃ hi tassa Byagghapajja mahato taḷākassa parihāni yeva pāṭikaṅkhā no vuddhi:
an8.54:6.7: evam eva kho Byagghapajja evaṃ samuppannānaṃ bhogānaṃ cattāri apāyamukhāni honti:
an8.54:6.8: itthidhutto hoti, surādhutto, akkhadhutto, pāpamitto pāpasahāyo pāpasampavaṅko. 9.
an8.54:7.1: Evaṃ samuppannānaṃ Byagghapajja bhogānaṃ cattāri āyamukhāni honti:
an8.54:7.2: na-itthidhutto hoti, na-surādhutto, naakkhadhutto, kalyāṇamitto kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko.
an8.54:7.3: Seyyathā pi Byagghapajja mahato taḷākassa cattāri c' eva āyamukhāni cattāri ca apāyamukhāni,
an8.54:7.4: tassa puriso yāni c' eva āyamukhāni tāni vivareyya, yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya,
an8.54:7.6: evaṃ hi tassa Byagghapajja mahato taḷākassa vuddhi yeva pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni:
an8.54:7.7: evam eva kho Byagghapajja evaṃ samuppannānaṃ bhogānaṃ cattāri āyamukhāni honti:
an8.54:7.8: na-itthidhutto hoti, na-surādhutto, naakkhadhutto, kalyāṇamitto kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko.
an8.54:8.1: Ime kho Byagghapajja cattāro dhammā kulaputtassa diṭṭhadhammahitāya saṃvattanti diṭṭhadhammasukhāya. 10.
an8.54:9.1: Cattāro 'me Byagghapajja dhammā kulaputtassa samparāyahitāya saṃvattanti samparāyasukhāya.
an8.54:10.2: Idha Byagghapajja kulaputto saddho hoti, saddahati Tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
an8.54:10.3: ‘iti pi so Bhagavā . . . pe . . . Satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho Bhagavā' ti.
an8.54:11.2: Idha Byagghapajja kulaputto pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti . . . pe . . . surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.
an8.54:12.2: Idha Byagghapajja kulaputto vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato.
an8.54:13.2: Idha Byagghapajja kulaputto paññavā hoti, udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
an8.54:14.1: Ime kho Byagghapajja cattāro dhammā kulaputtassa samparāyahitāya saṃvattanti samparāyasukhāyā ti.
